$comment: SEED per-document-type extraction/generation eval tasks. Expand to a real bank (10+ per docType) and populate `input` with source documents, then run live via run-eval.ts. The `candidateContent`/`candidateExtraction` fields let you score a captured model output offline (no DB/LLM needed) so the harness is runnable today. Generation pass = section coverage >= min AND zero forbidden hits; extraction pass = field F1 >= min.

Clinical background: the device treats condition Y. State of the art: current standard of care is described. Clinical data appraisal: literature and PMCF data were appraised for relevance and quality. Benefit-risk: the benefit-risk profile is acceptable for the intended population. Conclusions: the clinical evidence supports conformity.
